selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, timedatectl reported America/Toronto, /etc/localtime resolved to the Toronto zoneinfo file, and the files matched.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 8c28f3cd-ef9b-4edb-b26e-9a7a6f76c879; the reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to a75b4214-c05b-4dd5-b82d-3eec32929a42; system state returned to running with America/Toronto retained and zero failed units.

commands.command: id; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running; printf 'timezone='; timedatectl show -p Timezone --value; printf 'localtime_target='; readlink -f /etc/localtime; printf 'zoneinfo_present='; test -e /usr/share/zoneinfo/America/Toronto && echo yes || echo no
